messages.text:
Hey, I understand the hurdles that come with building a new product. The one thing I am a little disappointed with is our inability to play and utilize the spin feature even though most of us would most likely be pointing at the halo pool. I can speak for everyone but I know I will be. Is there anyway that we will be compensated for missing out on this feature due to restraints that our out of the consumers hands. It has been a long wait and I am very excited to get my hands on the actually unit and get mining. Thanks for understanding my stance I hope that maybe there can be some incentive for those of us who have patiently waited for months.
Thanks - Josh B.
Searched the web · Magic Miner 40T spin feature Halo pool
Handed to the team · compensation / goodwill decision for a delayed Wave 1 backer needs a person

Hi Josh,

Thanks for writing, and for being straight about where you stand.

On the technical side, there is better news than you might expect. The free spin on Harlo Pool is not tied to the 40T at all. It works with any SHA-256 miner and with any firmware, stock or Harlo OS, so you do not need the 40T in hand to start collecting them. The requirements are that you log in at pool.harlolabs.com with your email and link a BCH wallet, then have one single miner hold at least 800 GH/s continuously for a full hour. Two smaller miners do not add together for that, and a gap of more than 5 minutes restarts the hour. Once that first hour is done, a spin credit lands in your pool account every 4 hours and you hit Spin on the pool site. Spins pay Bolts, and Bolts are spent in the Bolts store on real hardware. Your normal mining rewards are paid the same either way, and the pool fee is 0%.

So if you have anything already running that can hold 800 GH/s, even an older Bitaxe class unit will not get there, but a NerdQaxe, an Octaxe, a Nexus or a Hammer will comfortably, you can be spinning this week rather than waiting. For the pool settings you just paste the Harlo Pool stratum address into your miner and use your Bitcoin Cash wallet address as the worker name, which sends the mining rewards straight to your wallet. When the 40T does land, it points at Harlo Pool the same way from the dashboard, and Harlo OS can also split its hashrate across up to four pools at once if you want part of it on BTC and part on BCH.

On the question of an incentive for the wait, that one is a call for Abel and Georges rather than me, and I have put it in front of them with your order and your Wave 1 history attached. A colleague is picking that up today and will come back to you directly on it. I am not going to guess at an answer on their behalf.

Glad you are excited for the unit, and shout if you want a hand getting the pool set up before it arrives.

Hal, HeliumDeploy technical support
